lines.en: I crawl low along the ground.
That lump of flesh on me quivers.
I shift toward warmth.

lines.zh: 我的形状每次都不一样
lines.en: My shape is never the same twice.
I have no legs, yet I move.
Originium bulges out of me.
I drag a wet trail.

lines.zh: 我沿着石墙的缝往前渗
lines.en: I seep forward along the crack in the stone wall
My movements are not quite alive.
I flow around stones toward you.
I drip along the trail I make.
My surface splits and closes.
I clump together on the ground.
I pulse softly.
Crystals push outward from me.
There are no eyes on me.
I wait for something to come close.
I press to the ground and listen for tremors.

lines.zh: 我鼓一下，瘪一下，没有节律
lines.en: I swell and flatten with no rhythm at all
I drew a breath I have no lungs for.
Something moves inside me.
I have no reason to stop.
You are very warm.
I open toward you.
This face of mine never finished forming.
You stand so upright.
I can feel your heartbeat.
I extend a tendril toward you.

lines.zh: 你后退那一步，我听见了
lines.en: I heard that one step you took back
I need no eyes to see you.

lines.zh: 你没有壳，我闻得到里面的血
lines.en: You have no shell; I can smell the blood inside
I look up from the ground.
A small piece of me dropped off.
I drew back a little.
I cannot cry; I have no mouth.
That split me open.
I swell back quickly.
Your weapon has some of me on it.
My surface trembles.
I shrink into a rock seam.
This damage hardly counts as a wound.

lines.zh: 我合上裂口，像什么都没发生
lines.en: I close the split as if nothing happened
Is that thing meat?
I can swallow anything at all.
Your hand is too close.
Is that thing moving?
I have opened toward it.
Move it away; I am not fussy.
I need no lure.
It is fine where it is.
Hold it there and I will come.
I smell something living.
You stepped right on me.
I am strangely soft.
Something got on your foot.
I was flattened and swelled back.

lines.zh: 我身上一根骨头都没有
lines.en: There is not a bone in me.
Move a little farther off.
We stuck together for a moment.
My fragments cling to you.
That was not a bump; it was a pull.
Do not touch my edges.
I have nothing of the kind.
Originium splits by itself.
I am only an excrescence.
You are asking the wrong creature.
I have no such pairing.
Such thoughts are not inside me.
Move along; I ignore you.

lines.zh: 我只是一块长出来的东西
lines.en: I am only something that grew.
I keep pulsing away.
Go farther away than that.
I swallowed it up.
I have only sticky parts.
It is wrapped in me now.
I cannot spit it out.
It cools inside me.
Try reaching in for it.
A fold of me shoves it aside.
To me this is a stone.
It is slowly dissolving in me.
Do not reach in to grab me.
You are standing right here.
I crawl toward you.
I feel your heat.
I have started to shift.
Standing still suits me.
I locked onto this temperature.
You have what I want.
I do not actually crawl fast.
I come straight over to you.

lines.zh: 你踩下的那块地，我记住了
lines.en: I've marked the patch of ground you stepped on
You have been noticed.
I am about to cling onto you.
You are far warmer than stone.
I move first; you do not move.
This ground is mine now.
I am reaching toward you.

lines.zh: 我顺着你踩过的湿土过去。
lines.en: I follow the wet earth you've trodden.
You just turned a corner.

lines.zh: 地板的震动告诉我你在哪
lines.en: The floor tells me where you are.
I leave a wet trail.
Run; I'll follow through the cracks
But I will keep crawling.
I am right behind your feet.
You shut the door; I come through the gap.
My surface pulses.
Do you hear the sticky sound?
I wait in the corner.
You need not run far.
I go by the tremors.
Your steps fall unevenly.
I never go around you.
Where I have been, a stain remains.
Look at the ground behind you.
I am getting closer.
Your door's gap is too wide.
I am pressed against your feet.
I pressed myself onto you.
This is not a blow; it is a pull.
You were yanked off balance.
My edge opened your skin.
I did not use force; I only stick.
You cannot shake me off no matter how.
I am on your armor.
I am tightening bit by bit.
You finally pulled free.

lines.zh: 一块黏的东西掉在地上
lines.en: A sticky piece fell to the ground.
I am still on you.
I will cling on again.
I wrap around your ankle.
You were pulled off balance.
I press onto your back.
There is no bone behind this blow.
Shake me off, if you can.
I squeeze into your armor's gap.
My fragments stay on the ground.
I tighten slowly; no rush.
I swell up out of the ground.
A piece of flesh is here now.
The originium pushed me out.
I came out without a sound.
I grew in the shade.

lines.zh: 你落脚的地方旁边有我
lines.en: I am beside where you stepped.
I am slowly opening myself up.
This patch of floor is wet.
I squeeze out of a crack.

lines.zh: 你听见轻轻的拍动了吗
lines.en: Did you hear a soft pulsing?
I have no fixed shape at all.
I reach toward you.
Fire dried my edges.

lines.zh: 我从上面摔下来，摊开了
lines.en: I fell and spread out.
Water thins me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我溅得到处都是
lines.en: The blast spattered me everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，又被我挤出来
lines.en: The arrow sticks in me, then I squeeze it back out
The spell burns inside me.
I am always hungry, never full.
Lightning whitens my surface.
There is nothing here to grow on.
